$comment: Single config source for the pack origin (asset-pack-system). The CSP here is the one the protocol adapter delivers on every HTML response — tauri.conf.json's own csp does NOT reach custom-protocol pages (spike finding, design.md D1). style-src 'unsafe-inline' is required because Monaco injects <style> elements; xkin needs no unsafe-eval.
csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:
$comment_terminal: Which shell a session starts (change terminal-surface, design Open Question 1). Candidates are tried in order, but the user's own $SHELL wins on Unix when it exists — a session should behave like a terminal they opened themselves. %COMSPEC% is deliberately NOT consulted on Windows: it is cmd.exe on essentially every machine, which would make the worst available shell the default one everywhere. scrollback_lines is the bound terminal-surface requires be stated; xterm.js's own default is 1000.
